A small pattern created with the guild's artisan recipe.

Faction: Tailor's Guild (400 points)</rgb>

Use this item to immediately gain reputation in this faction or turn in a stack for a 3-day reputation item.

1879127708.name: Storm-hammer
1879127708.desc: When applied to a legendary item, this title provides additional lightning damage to lightning based skills.

1879132444.name: Brushed Magnificent Leather

1879135388.name: Cup of Red Tea

1879138204.name: Sealed Burglar's Tools of the Second Age

1879143452.name: Khazâd-iron Caltrops
1879143452.desc: Caltrops damage the target while decreasing its run speed.\n\nMost effective against targets level 60 or lower.

1879146780.name: Tame Redhorn-goat
1879146780.desc: The Iron Garrison Miners have been training Redhorn mountain-goats to use as mounts. These sure-footed creatures can traverse the rocky passageways of Moria where no horse could go. This is one of their tame goats, making it not as fast as others.

1879147804.name: Egg of the Mistress
1879147804.desc: A large egg from the Queen of the Nameless. This will be of some value to the taxidermists of Moria.

1879149980.name: Barricade
1879149980.desc: This hastily-erected barricade is constructed of low-quality materials.

1879153564.name: Platinum Inlay
1879153564.desc: An inlay that can be quickly applied to a Rune-stone. The next induction cannot be interrupted.

1879155356.name: Gravestone
1879155356.desc: A gravestone near the haunted village of Audaghaim.

1879161884.name: Resplendent Gloves of Lothlórien Scroll Case
1879161884.desc: On opening, the scroll case will reveal the Resplendent Gloves of Lothlórien recipe.\n\nYou must be friendly with the Galadhrim and Artisan of the Tailor's Guild to use this item.

1879163932.name: Token of Burning
1879163932.desc: The Token of Burning is an item of Power crafted by the Elves of the Second Age. Using this item will affect your enemy with a damaging effect for a short time as long as your enemy does not move too far from the empowered point.

1879165596.name: Sealed Burglar's Tools of the Third Age

1879166620.name: Lost Pages
1879166620.desc: This page contains a copy of the missing history of Audaghaim.

1879167388.name: Legacy of Fate

1879180828.name: Herbalist Skill: Salve of Resolve
1879180828.desc: Instructions that you share with your Herbalist, allowing access to a new skill.

1879189404.name: Sturdy Artisan Tailor's Tools

1879190556.name: Clue

1879192092.name: Cut of Delicious Meat

1879196700.name: Fall Injury Immunity

1879199516.desc: Rune-keepers can attune themselves to specially crafted chisels, enhancing their powers.

Horns can momentarily stun up to 6 nearby targets.

Most effective against targets of your level or lower.

1879357596.name: Web-covered Page

1879360796.name: Tome of the Lhingris Crawler

1879362588.name: Seregost Spire - Windowed
1879362588.desc: A replica of a spire from Seregost, replete with glowing red windows. It has been re-sized to abide by local housing regulations.

1879363484.name: Dwarf-axe

1879363612.name: Snakewood

1879365660.name: Caparison of Lasgalen Spring
1879365660.desc: This item will reward your character with the Mounted Combat appearance trait, Caparison of Lasgalen Spring.

1879367836.name: Abandoned Shackles
1879367836.desc: He cast off the shackles when he escaped... or when he was set loose on a fell purpose.

1879370012.name: Water Jug
1879370012.desc: A crude clay jug for holding water.

1879379228.name: Large Map of Eriador (2nd Edition)

1879380508.name: Soothing Hymn of Dwarf-holds

1879385756.name: Ironfold Metalsmith Crafting

1879386780.name: River Reed
1879386780.desc: These reeds can be dried and used in crafts.

1879387420.name: Hidden Cache
1879387420.desc: A missing Beorning cache containing various supplies.

1879388572.name: Obsidian Dwarf-make Bed

1879391388.name: Hope-armaments of the Elvish Shield-maiden

1879414556.name: Wild Herb

This cracked tracery may be traded with the scholars of the Archives of Rivendell for Legendary traceries that may be engraved upon your legendary items.

These items do not go into carry-alls or the barter wallet.

<rgb=#FFFF00>Barter this token in Rivendell for Level 50 Legendary Traceries.</rgb>

1879440156.name: Heartwood Accessory

1879441308.name: Bounty: War Dispatches
1879441308.desc: A bounty for collecting war dispatches from the Angmarim of the Iron Crown in Câr Bronach.

1879442588.name: Provisions Crate
1879442588.desc: This crate contains numerous provisions for the use of the Rangers of Tornhad.

1879444892.name: Lost Satchel
1879444892.desc: A satchel dropped by someone in a hurry.

1879446428.name: Hunting Net
1879446428.desc: A net made from finely twisted rope.

1879446556.name: Ledger
